title: Ayre Battles: Heritage Academy
author: IamLordeyayaya_0
selftext: The idea was to create a fighting game but with cards. So range is major thing here. certain moves only work in the correct range or get optimized there. Clash against any player card the enemy tries to strike you with defensive, evasive or damaging attacks of your own. every action you take can be reacted to in some way. ik it says Wishlist on steam but the page isnt ready yet lol bare with me during its final stretch. Demo is free to play on itch now. no downloaded needed you can play from your browser. you will want  a pc to play it on tho. here's the trailer what do you think?
